summary: Opt-in prefix store: chat with thinking TTFT -49 % (Metal) / -25 % (CUDA), agent -15 % / -22 %, RAG neutral; restored output bitwise the store-on cold output on cpu, CUDA, Metal. Store-on vs store-off not bitwise for the hybrid, so default-off; PR #113 draft.
lessons: The cpu GatedDeltaNet hybrid prefill is not chunk-invariant (tiny fixture), so any store that moves chunk boundaries changes hybrid bits vs store-off.
Metal ttft numbers in the measurements are chat/agent totals over 8 requests each (intarsia bench reuse, not localeval: localeval has no multi-turn mode and nonces its prompts).
A template whose generation prompt ends at the header (Qwen3) needs the entry stored by the final pass; only a real-model gate found it.
Cutting before every message start tripled TTFT on the MoE: each pass reads all experts.
Metal store-off TTFT passes 1-2 come from quiet slot #4472 (a script bug lost them in exclusive #4322); the third off pass from #4322 agrees within 4 %.
